name: Booked base
limitations: Closed lots. Scope is four booked costs and gross revenue.

name: Higher feeder basis
limitations: Same placements and entry kg. Commercial bid costs excluded.

name: Higher allocated feed
limitations: Fixed intake, days, gain, grade and survival.

name: Finisher feed repriced
limitations: Lot–phase booked exposure is imputed from daily delivery shares.

name: Concentrate repriced
limitations: Recorded ingredient cost shares proxy the allocation. Ration formulas stay fixed.

name: Lower carcass CAD/kg
limitations: Same sold HCW and grade mix. No individual grid components.

name: Lower carcass percentage
limitations: Uniform percentage of eligible booked revenue, with the same HCW and grade mix.

name: Adverse prices
limitations: Concurrent illustrative accounting stress at observed volumes.

name: Favorable prices
limitations: Concurrent illustrative upside at observed volumes.

name: Lower mortality, conservative finish
limitations: Conditional finish terms for 60 hypothetical survivors. No treatment or success rate is inferred.

name: Lower mortality, favorable finish
limitations: Same 60 hypothetical survivors, with alternative finish terms. No probability is attached.

name: Higher mortality
limitations: 60 hypothetical additional deaths. Avoidable costs are assumed shares, with no inferred death date.

name: Adverse prices and higher mortality
limitations: Adverse repricing precedes lost sales and avoided costs. Identities are a reproducible allocation.
